title: An Auditable Symbolic-RAG-Generative AI Architecture for Goal-Oriented Conversation Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2609.07152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal-oriented conversational systems must answer factual questions, understand visitor-provided information, and advance business objectives without becoming rigid questionnaires. This paper proposes a Symbolic-RAG-Generative architecture centered on the Goal-oriented Retrieval-Augmented Conversation Engine (GRACE). An instruction-constrained Business Goal Compiler transforms business intent into an immutable objective set, normalized priority vector, canonical questions, and initial state vector. At runtime, GRACE receives the complete conversation history, latest visitor message, current state, and grounded answer generated by a separate RAG component. It updates completion only from visitor-authored evidence and selects one contextually modulated follow-up. The core policy maximizes expected business progress subject to a minimum visitor-utility constraint. We formalize the state, monotonic transitions, source separation, question mod

translated_title: 一种用于面向目标对话编排的可审计符号-RAG-生成式AI架构
translated_abstract: 面向目标的对话系统必须能够回答事实性问题、理解访客提供的信息，并推进业务目标，同时又不能沦为僵硬的问卷。本文提出了一种以“面向目标的检索增强对话引擎”（GRACE）为核心的符号-RAG-生成式架构。一个受指令约束的业务目标编译器将业务意图转换为不可变的目标集合、归一化的优先级向量、规范问题集以及初始状态向量。在运行时，GRACE接收完整的对话历史、最新的访客消息、当前状态，以及由独立的RAG组件生成的有据可依的答案。系统仅根据访客本人提供的证据来更新目标完成度，并选择一个结合上下文进行调节的后续追问。核心策略在满足最低访客效用约束的前提下，最大化预期的业务进展。我们形式化地定义了状态、单调转换、来源分离、问题模……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了以GRACE引擎为核心的可审计符号-RAG-生成式AI架构，通过业务目标编译器将业务意图固化为不可变目标，并仅基于访客本人提供的证据推进对话，在保证最低访客效用约束下最大化业务进展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an auditable Symbolic-RAG-Generative AI architecture centered on the GRACE engine, which compiles business intents into immutable objectives and advances conversations using only visitor-authored evidence, maximizing expected business progress under a minimum visitor-utility constraint.
